name: Tachibana no Tomomasa
source:
One of the Hachiyou, he is the Byakko of Earth. Like Takamichi, Tomomasa is a nobleman, employed as a Lieutenant of the Left Imperial Guard. He is aloof and easy-going, and though he hides it much of the time, he is a good judge of character. His elemental attribute is Swamp, and his dragon jewel is located between his collar bones.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harukanaru_Toki_no_Naka_de]Wikipedia[/url]]
